summary: Iteration 150 - Taxi Customer Flow (Uber-like UI) - All tests PASS. New customer-focused /taxi page verified with Uber-like vehicle labels (UberX, Comfort, XL), address autocomplete working with short input (2-3 chars), map zoom on selection, price updates, and old B2B routes redirected to home.

tests: Search 'Pot' (3 chars) - Shows 6 suggestions (Potsdamer Platz, Potsdamer Straße, Potsdam, etc.)
Search 'Ale' (3 chars) - Shows 6 suggestions (Alexanderplatz, Alexandrinenstraße, etc.)
Selection updates route, prices, and map zoom

new_customer_taxi_page.details: /taxi shows new Uber-like customer-focused UI with 'Fahrt buchen' heading, 'WIE BEI UBER' label, simple vehicle selection

address_autocomplete_short_input.details: Search responds to 2-3 character input (e.g., 'Pot' shows Potsdamer Platz, 'Ale' shows Alexanderplatz)

selection_updates_route_prices_zoom.details: Selecting a suggestion updates: route display, prices for all vehicles (UberX €7.52, Comfort €11.62, XL €8.96), map zooms to show A/B markers with route line

uber_like_vehicle_selection.details: Vehicle options labeled as UberX (Empfohlen), Comfort, XL with descriptions and prices

book_button_and_ride_status.details: Book button shows 'Bestellen · €X.XX' when destination selected, data-testid='taxi-customer-active-ride-card' exists for active rides

old_routes_removed.details: /taxi-partner, /taxi-dashboard, /taxi/pro all redirect to home page, no old B2B taxi UI visible

test_credentials: No auth required for taxi customer flow testing
seed_data_creation: Used existing seeded driver (Ahmed Yilmaz) for nearby drivers test
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 150 verified the new Uber-like taxi customer flow. Key data-testids: taxi-customer-page, taxi-customer-input-pickup, taxi-customer-input-dropoff, taxi-customer-suggestions-dropoff, taxi-customer-vehicle-standard/premium/van, taxi-customer-book-button, taxi-customer-active-ride-card. Backend APIs /api/taxi/status, /api/taxi/drivers/nearby, /api/taxi/estimate, /api/taxi/geocode all working. Old routes /taxi-partner, /taxi-dashboard, /taxi/pro redirect to home.

mocked_apis.note: All endpoints use real backend with MongoDB and Mapbox geocoding
